intro: Flexible day menus, not a fixed six-day itinerary. Existing confirmed bookings and arrival/departure times take precedence. New options are separate from original 94.
transit_note: Local fares and live journey times not quoted: use live rail routing. Approximate dayparts allow for queues and browsing.

options.title: Tokyo Great Cycling Tour - Route L
options.what: A guided three-hour east-Tokyo ride through Ryogoku, Asakusa, Ueno and Akihabara, rather than an independent rental.
options.price: ¥9,000 per adult; ¥45,000 for five. Bike, helmet, water and guide included; lunch extra.
constraints: 9:00 AM or 1:00 PM starts; about 17 km.
Published group limit 2–15; November five-seat availability unverified.
Passes Ueno Park. Verify exact stops with the operator; no garden or museum visit is added as a separate activity.
No handheld filming while riding; stop safely.

options.title: DIG West-Side Cycling & Food Tour
options.what: A guided 3.5–4-hour local-life ride through Koenji, Nakano and Asagaya, including lunch, street-food tastes and a drink.
options.price: ¥15,000 per person; ¥75,000 for five. Published small-group rate, not a November seat guarantee.
constraints: 9:30 AM or 2:30 PM departures; 9:30 AM fits a relaxed start.
Published group size 3–8; five fit, but November seats are unverified.
12–15 km; confident urban cycling required. Request five free helmets.
Does not cater for dietary requirements or allergies. Confirm the food plan before selecting.
Usually runs in rain; stop safely before filming and return bikes before drinking.

options.title: TOKYOBIKE TOKYO rental
options.what: Independent standard pedal bicycle rental for coffee shops and local backstreet exploring.
constraints: Book up to 30 days ahead; photo ID; reserve each rider’s size.
Return to same shop; rental hours Wed–Fri 11:00–17:30, Sat/Sun 10:00–17:30.
Closed Mon/Tue: not Nov 16. Fleet availability unconfirmed.

options.title: Tokyobike Yanaka Soil rental
options.what: Independent pedal-bike rental for old-Tokyo neighbourhood lanes; shop return required.
constraints: Closed Tue/Wed/Thu: not Nov 11–12.
Photo ID and bike-size reservation recommended. Confirm rental hand-back time on booking.

options.title: Docomo Tokyo Bike Share
options.what: Electric-assist bikes for short local hops; less dependable for securing an entire group fleet.
options.price: ¥165/30 min; ¥1,650 convenience-store day pass; ¥2,200 staffed IC-card day pass
constraints: Convenience-store pass requires SMS; verify phone compatibility.
IC pass requires contactable phone + photo ID; locate staffed seller first.
Return only at supported port and confirm completion; stock/hours vary.
Pass ends 23:59 same day, not 24 hours.

options.title: Sunshine Aquarium
options.what: Rooftop aquarium near home base; indoor tanks plus weather-exposed rooftop exhibits.
constraints: Autumn/winter generally weekdays 10:00–18:00, weekends 09:30–18:00; last 30 min before.
Recheck exact November calendar; weekend timed reservations recommended.

packages.title: Guided bikes, food & vintage
packages.travel: Start with the booked Koenji meeting point. Ride with the guide, return the bike, then browse locally.
packages.budget_note: DIG small-group rate ¥15,000 per person includes lunch and snacks. Shopping and evening food/drinks extra.

sequence.title: DIG West-Side Cycling & Food Tour
sequence.what: About 3.5–4 hours, 12–15 km and local food. Five seats must be confirmed; this is not booked.

sequence.title: Koenji vintage browsing
sequence.what: One flexible shopping anchor. Choose the shops you like rather than trying to tick off every store.

sequence.title: Dinner near your current area
sequence.what: No extra cross-city activity required after a substantial bike tour.

must_book: Five seats on the same guided departure; request helmets and discuss food requirements.
constraints: No handheld filming while cycling. Stop safely for clips.
This tour normally runs in rain; check its cancellation terms.
packages.rain_alternative: Change only within operator terms. Use existing vintage shops/covered lanes if the ride is cancelled.

packages.title: Camera gear, beef & arcade games
packages.travel: One camera-shopping block, one meal, one optional arcade stop. Everything stays in the Shinjuku area.
packages.budget_note: Camera purchases are outside the food/activity budget. Black Hole courses ¥5,478 or ¥7,678 per person, optional drinks extra.

sequence.title: Camera-shopping anchor
sequence.what: Yodobashi opens 9:30 AM, Kitamura 10:00 AM and Map Camera 11:00 AM. Choose one or two stores; this is one anchor, not three separate activities.

sequence.title: Yakiniku Black Hole
sequence.what: Tabletop beef grilling with a 100-minute course; reserve a table for five.

sequence.title: namco TOKYO
sequence.what: Crane games and arcade play; swap for batting if that is the mood.

sequence.title: Godzilla street view
sequence.what: A short exterior clip/photo stop, not another admission. The hotel terrace is closed.

must_book: Black Hole table if selected; exact date availability unverified.
constraints: Ask before filming inside camera shops. Check item condition, warranty and language before purchases.
Do not film in Omoide Yokocho without its required prior permission.
packages.rain_alternative: This is already mostly indoors; skip outdoor clips in poor weather.

packages.title: Street karts, chicken & streetwear
packages.area: Shibuya → Harajuku, only if time permits
packages.travel: Keep the road activity separate from the bicycle day. Add one nearby shopping block, not a tour of every district.
packages.budget_note: Street Kart regular starting rate ¥20,000 per person before optional coverage. Exact November quote unverified; meals and purchases extra.

sequence.time: 9:30 AM check-in for a proposed 10:00 AM start
sequence.title: Street Kart Shibuya H-S
sequence.what: One-hour public-road tour. Confirm five matching karts and all driver documents before paying.

sequence.title: Good Wood Terrace
sequence.what: Jamaican jerk chicken with rice and peas. The seasoning may contain fish sauce; it is not a fish-free guarantee.

sequence.title: Streetwear + vintage block
sequence.what: Choose Shibuya PARCO or a Harajuku resale loop. Many shops open late morning/noon.

sequence.title: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
sequence.what: Handheld personal travel capture without obstructing pedestrians. Commercial/staged filming needs separate checks.

sequence.title: WREP hip-hop or Bridge house
sequence.what: Social DJ bars in the same Shibuya building. Choose one; check the actual night’s lineup and entry policy. Never put drinks before the kart tour.

must_book: Driver-document checks and five karts on one departure.
constraints: Not Nintendo or Mario Kart. Single-seat vehicles, no passenger substitute.
Stay sober and never hold a camera while driving.
Skip the kart anchor entirely if licensing, insurance or weather does not work.
packages.rain_alternative: Choose the indoor shopping and meal stops; do not assume a weather cancellation refund.

packages.title: Lift, a proper meal & your own court
packages.travel: Aim for a later-afternoon private court after any gym visit. Do not squeeze an 11:00 AM gym start, lunch and transfer into an assumed 2:00 PM court arrival.
packages.budget_note: LÝFT is a ¥22,000 seven-day pass, not a cheap one-off visit. This upfront cost plus court, food and transport can consume or exceed a $100–200 day. Confirm eligibility before buying.

sequence.title: LÝFT GÝM, only if visitor eligibility is confirmed
sequence.what: Official FAQ residency wording means tourist entry is not established. Do not buy or schedule as guaranteed.

sequence.title: CHERMSIDE steak sandwich
sequence.what: A meat sandwich and fries near Harajuku. Five may wait or split seating; do not lock an unverified meal duration.

sequence.title: Private pickleball at NEON Shibuya
sequence.what: Your own court: four play doubles while the fifth rotates. Four paddles and two balls included.

must_book: Book a private court, not open play or a class.
constraints: NEON Nov 12, 2–3 PM showed one slot on Oct 27. It is not held and is too tight to assume after a relaxed gym/lunch. If choosing that slot, skip or separate the gym.
If gym access is not possible, keep lunch + pickleball as the two anchors.
SEIBU Shinagawa is a separate indoor private-court alternative, not an extra court on the same day.
packages.rain_alternative: Both courts are indoors. If no court is secured, leave the activity unassigned rather than invent availability.

packages.title: Cook ramen, wander & choose the evening
packages.travel: Use a Seibu local train from Ikebukuro to Ekoda. Keep this lighter day close to base, with no competing full-day tour.
packages.budget_note: Cooking ¥13,000 per person includes one ramen bowl and five gyoza; replaces lunch plus one paid activity. Evening spending optional.

sequence.time: Request a 9:00 AM or noon class
sequence.title: Chef Yoshi ramen + gyoza
sequence.what: Two-hour English cooking experience. Five fit the stated group limit; date/time is requestable, not confirmed.

sequence.title: Free time near Ikebukuro
sequence.what: Keep room for wandering or rest. No extra attraction is required.

sequence.time: Optional evening, if you want a night out
sequence.title: POPINN.GINZA
sequence.what: A separate trip to a small hip-hop/R&B bar; choose it only if the group wants the travel. Smoking indoors.

must_book: Operator must accept the class request before invoice/payment; no request submitted.
POPINN accepts reservations for 3+, but travel-date seats/DJ lineup unverified.
constraints: Chicken ramen is not a guaranteed fish-free recipe. Ask about tare/dashi and fillings if complete avoidance matters.
Ask the host before filming the class.
packages.rain_alternative: The class is indoors; keep the afternoon flexible.

fuji.title: Optional Fuji: only for clear weather
fuji.what: A whole-day lake-and-mountain-view excursion, not climbing Mt Fuji.
fuji.recommendation: Optional only, not a default day in this plan. It gives up most of a Tokyo day. Keep it here for a late decision only if the group changes its mind, the near-date forecast/live view is clear and both transport legs work. No November visibility forecast is claimed now.
fuji.transport: Ikebukuro→Shinjuku JR, then Busta 4 F via New South Gate. Direct coach headline about 1 hour 45 minutes; traffic can extend it. Budget roughly 2.5–3 hours each way from Ikebukuro including transfers as a planning allowance, not timetable.
fuji.price: Coach ¥2,000 one-way online Fujiyama Connect / ¥2,200 counter; local rail, buses and food extra.
fuji.booking: Reserved seats; same-day online offered subject to availability. Secure the return too. No booking made.
fuji.rail_alternative: FUJI EXCURSION fastest 1 hour 53 minutes Shinjuku→Kawaguchiko, assigned-seat booking recommended; through fare must be checked, not outdated 2024 ¥4,130. Tickets generally open 10:00 JST one month ahead.
sequence: Local bus to lakeshore / Oishi Park for Fuji across the lake
Lunch: consider hoto, wide wheat noodles and vegetables in miso broth; restaurant unselected
constraints: Full day opportunity cost; skip if cloudy.
No summit climbing: official summit trails closed out of season.
Local bus times/fares need recheck; do not squeeze ropeway and pagoda into same simple plan.
fuji.cloudy_alternative: Keep your chosen Tokyo day. There is no reason to sacrifice a full day for a clouded mountain view.

safety.text: Ride left on roadways; sidewalks only where permitted, pedestrians first. Obey lights and stops, use lights at night, wear a helmet, never cycle after alcohol. Stop before using navigation.

excluded.title: Wakasu bicycle rentals
excluded.reason: Closed for renovations until expected April 2027.

archived_options.title: Shinjuku Gyoen
archived_options.what: Japanese and landscaped gardens: a calm daylight break before neon Shinjuku.
constraints: November 09:00–16:30, last entry 16:00.
Open daily Nov 1–15; CLOSED Mon Nov 16.
Do not promise peak autumn foliage.
archived_options.archive_reason: Removed from active recommendations at the group’s request on October 27, 2026: gardens and traditional museums are not a trip priority.

archived_options.title: Tokyo National Museum
archived_options.what: Japanese art, Buddhist sculpture and historic objects: an indoor cultural anchor.
constraints: 09:30–17:00; Fri/Sat until 20:00, last entry 30 min before.
CLOSED Mon Nov 16. Honkan Room 4 closed during trip, not entire museum.
Online collection ticket recommended; not a fixed-time slot.
archived_options.archive_reason: Removed from active recommendations at the group’s request on October 27, 2026: gardens and traditional museums are not a trip priority.

archived_options.title: Kiyosumi Gardens
archived_options.what: A strolling pond garden with ornamental rocks and stepping stones; explore on foot after parking legally.
constraints: 09:00–17:00, last entry 16:30; no regular weekly closure.
archived_options.archive_reason: Removed from active recommendations at the group’s request on October 27, 2026: gardens and traditional museums are not a trip priority.
